description: This file defines the OpenIdProvider entity class for use with Doctrine ORM. It maps to the 'ohrm_openid_provider' database table and includes properties for provider ID, name, URL, and status with corresponding getter and setter methods.

classes.name: OpenIdProvider
classes.description: Doctrine entity class representing an OpenID provider with properties for ID, name, URL, and status, along with accessor methods.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the OpenID provider.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the ID of the OpenID provider.

methods.name: getStatus
methods.description: Returns the status of the provider (active/inactive).

methods.name: setStatus
methods.description: Sets the status of the provider.
